# ankra_ankracloud_plans (Data Source)

The Ankra Cloud server plans, cheapest first, for the `*_plan` arguments of `ankra_ankracloud_cluster`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_ankracloud_plans" "all" {}

locals {
  # Plans are listed cheapest first.
  smallest_four_core_plan = [for plan in data.ankra_ankracloud_plans.all.plans : plan.name if plan.cores >= 4][0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `credential_id` (String) Ankra Cloud credential to read the catalogue through. Unset uses the organisation's built-in Ankra Cloud credential.

### Read-Only

- `incomplete_reasons` (List of String) Why `pricing_complete` is false; empty when it is true.
- `plans` (Attributes List) Server plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))
- `pricing_complete` (Boolean) Whether every plan carries a monthly price; when false, some `price_monthly_cents` are 0.

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the plan can be ordered.
- `category` (String) Plan family label.
- `cores` (Number) vCPU cores.
- `family` (String) Plan family.
- `memory_mebibytes` (Number) Memory in MiB.
- `name` (String) Plan name.
- `price_monthly_cents` (Number) Monthly price in cents; 0 when the plan carries no price.
- `storage_gibibytes` (Number) Root storage in GiB.
